description.zh: 搜索版本关键词 支持模糊查询
description.en: The keyword for searching versions. Fuzzy match is supported.

description.zh: 一次获取的最大记录数
description.en: The maximum number of records to retrieve in a single request.

description.zh: 下一页token，为null表示没有下一页
description.en: The pagination token for the next page. A value of null indicates that no more pages are available.
The usage. Set to Explorer to retrieve meta information.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iacservice list-terraform-provider-versions --keyword key --next-token ar9lHbaidqWequN5orMba54dD+2BRJj42DLT6GrZysw= --max-results 20 --usage Explorer --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iacservice GET /version/terraform/provider --region cn-hangzhou --nextToken 'ar9lHbaidqWequN5orMba54dD+2BRJj42DLT6GrZysw=' --maxResults 20 --usage Explorer --keyword key --header "Content-Type=application/json"
